g.text: A799 · Keep yesterday’s records exact
22 OCT 2026 · A–F AGREED WITHIN PRECISE SCOPES
F is answered. The complete design, plan and build are not yet approved. These static boards support one planning-only
approval question.
A / B / C · Agreed scope
A · Let the old product write
Use an invented venue written through an immutable older
product’s normal paths. No private venue data, current
writers or domain seed SQL.
B · Two required sources
Every candidate checks the oldest supported and previous
retained source releases before publication. Count equal
endpoints once.
C · Keep originals retrievable
Each release’s bundle and independent facts live in its own
GitHub Release on the Waitron repository; checksums stay in
Git. Verify private CI downloads later through existing
access. No new token or permission expansion.
F · Explicit retirement agreed
One post-reset history
Imagine qualified sources R1, R2, R3, R4 and candidate R5.
R1 is oldest supported; R4 is previous retained. These are
invented labels, not passing results.
Required for R5: R1 and R4
The oldest stays until the owner explicitly retires it and
names its replacement. No automatic rolling window.
Hypothetical only: R2 and R4
An explicit R1 retirement naming R2 as replacement
effective for R5 would change the required sources. No
specific retirement is approved.
Keep every R1–R4 original
Keep every bundle and expectation set, even after
retirement. Unrun releases get no passing result. No
published support guarantee changes.
D / E · Original facts stay exact
D · Required issued F1
F1 means a full customer invoice. Harbour’s invoice to Mara
Soler, 18 Market Street, must keep its original recorded
name/address even if live customer details later change.
This example is invented.
No substitute for issued F1
Missing normal-path F1 needs an evidence-based
prerequisite; A799 stays open. An unpaid order, F2 receipt,
restart, new sale or new fiscal writer cannot fill the gap.
No F1 enablement is authorised.
E · Keep assigned values
Keep the exact IDs, invoice numbers, dates and timestamps
the old product assigned. Freeze independent expectations
before candidate access. A fresh capture with different
values gets a new version and independent review; keep
every original.
Proposed design · Capture and upgrade
A760 authority stays separate
Capture only after its separately authorised reset, within
the same resulting migration history. A qualifying
immutable source is still needed.
Seal the whole stopped state
Keep product transcripts, matching
database/configuration/key files, historical triggers and
independent expectations. Verify checksums. Candidate code
cannot write the originals or expectations.
Use the real candidate boot
Use an isolated disposable copy and normal packaged entry.
A distinct later candidate must apply actual pending
migrations. Same-image runs are restart-only. No reset,
restore or new identity.
Keep optional modules off
Retain disabled-module rows through a supported toggle.
Otherwise use a never-enabled fixture and report
retained-data coverage missing.
Proposed design · Two results
First: preserve old history
Compare original IDs, relationships, exact scales, dates,
names, schema/protections and raw fiscal bytes. Keep
node/SIF installation/series identity, next number and
chain head. Candidate output never supplies expectations.
Then: a separate new sale
Yesterday’s 0.350 kg cheese line at €22.00/kg stays €7.70.
A new line at €24.00/kg is €8.40. Use another preserved
copy and the same identity/chain. These are illustrative
calculations.
Neither result fills the other
New-sale success cannot repair failed preservation or
missing issued F1. Keep fiscal writers, golden huella and
inmutabilidad unchanged. Missing/corrupt inputs and cleanup
failures block the run.
One question · Planning only
Complete-design approval
Do you approve this complete design for preparing the
implementation plan, with all conditions preserved?
Recommendation: yes
This authorises PLAN ONLY: a documentation-only plan,
separately reviewed and landed before a later build
decision. It does not approve the unwritten plan.
No execution authority
No build, capture, runtime probe, migration, A760 reset,
upload, fiscal change or F1 enablement. Landing the plan
grants none of these authorities.
Plan must assess real prerequisites
Evaluate actual interfaces, safe identity seams,
image/platform availability, module paths, containment,
budgets and private downloads through existing access.
Missing prerequisites block runtime work; do not loosen
requirements.
STATIC DESIGN ARTWORK · NO RUNTIME EVIDENCE. Historical source reads remain UNVERIFIED at runtime. No qualifying capture, migration, upgrade,
preservation, new-sale, size, timing or access result is shown.
